key_finding: Disk I/O contributes only ~1.5% to bubble ratio. The dominant bottleneck (86.8% in host-only) is synchronization overhead (cudaStreamSynchronize + pending_cv_.wait), NOT disk reads. The existing prefetcher already hides most disk latency. Optimization priority: Phase 1 (event-based sync) > Phase 2 (hit/miss dispatch) >> Phase 3 (prefetch).

optimization_implication.phase_2_hit_miss_split: HIGH IMPACT — reduces serialization in dispatch pipeline
optimization_implication.phase_3_prefetch: LOW-MEDIUM IMPACT — disk already hidden; mainly helps cold-cache scenarios
